# About

Systematic multi-database search strategy, study eligibility criteria, and hybrid AI + human curation workflow for the Proteomic GWAS Catalogue.
:::
:::

::: {.about-section}
## 1. Search Strategy

New and historical studies are identified using a scripted, reproducible **four-source search and dual-axis triage pipeline** (`src/run_literature_search.R` and `src/search/lexicons.R`) executed via GitHub Actions:

1. **PubMed (NCBI E-utilities `esearch` + `efetch` XML):**
   Modular Boolean queries combining Medical Subject Headings (`Proteomics`, `Proteome`, `Genome-Wide Association Study`, `Quantitative Trait Loci`) and free-text title/abstract terms covering affinity and untargeted platforms (`SomaScan`, `SomaLogic`, `SOMAmer`, `aptamer-based`, `Olink`, `Explore 3072`, `Explore HT`, `proximity extension`, `SCALLOP`, `NULISA`, `NULISAseq`, `Simoa`, `DIA-MS`, `SWATH`, `Orbitrap Astral`, `timsTOF`, `TMT`, `Proteograph`, `LC-MS/MS`, `MRM/PRM`, `Luminex`, `Bio-Plex`, `Milliplex`, `Rules-Based Medicine`) paired with germline genetic association terms (`GWAS`, `pGWAS`, `pQTL`, `cis-pQTL`, `trans-pQTL`, `vQTL`, `exome-wide`, `whole-genome sequencing`, `genetic architecture`). Queries deliberately omit `"Humans"[mh]` so recently indexed articles and NIH preprints lacking MeSH annotations are retained.
2. **Europe PMC (`MED` + `PMC` + Preprints `PPR` + `METHODS`):**
   Two sharded `TITLE_ABS:` queries (`Platforms + Anchors` and `Proteome + Analytes`) retrieve peer-reviewed articles and preprints across **bioRxiv**, **medRxiv**, **openRxiv (`10.64898/`)**, **Research Square**, and **Preprints.org** without restricting to open-access subsets, paired with a full-text `METHODS:` search prong rescuing multi-omics studies that name proteomic platforms and GWAS software (`REGENIE`, `BOLT-LMM`, `fastGWA`, `SAIGE`, `MatrixEQTL`, `tensorQTL`, `QTLtools`) only in their Methods section.
3. **NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog (REST API v2):**
   Queries date-sorted `/v2/publications` alongside `EFO_0004747` (*protein measurement*), verifying protein measurement traits directly across `disease_trait` labels (`>= 5` distinct non-lipid/CRP/albumin protein traits) so large summary-statistics deposits lacking abstract platform keywords or formal EFO curation are captured.
4. **Citation Network Snowballing & Preprint Lineage Tracking:**
   Performs forward citation (`CITES:`) and date-bounded reference snowballing from a 10-paper landmark pGWAS seed set across platforms and tissues, and monitors active preprints across `api.biorxiv.org/pubs/`, Europe PMC `commentCorrectionList`, and Crossref `is-preprint-of` relations (`src/apply_preprint_upgrades.R`) to replace superseded preprints with peer-reviewed publications automatically.
5. **Blinded Positive-Control Validation:**
   Search recall and triage survival are benchmarked against an air-gapped positive-control study set (`src/evaluate_positive_controls.R --mode blinded-summary`) that is never read by the search scripts.

For full methodological details — including the `v1` through `v3+` iterations, blinded multi-agent benchmark replications, and capture-recapture sensitivity estimates — see the dedicated [**Search Strategy**](search-strategy.qmd) page.
:::

::: {.about-section}
## 2. Inclusion & Exclusion Criteria

### Inclusion Criteria
* **Primary germline protein GWAS / pQTL / vQTL mapping:** Studies generating new individual-level genotype-to-protein association results (array GWAS, WES, WGS, *cis*-only mapping, variance-QTL mapping, or sex-/ancestry-stratified analyses) or primary multi-cohort consortium pGWAS meta-analyses.
* **All proteomic technologies:** Affinity aptamer (`SomaScan`), proximity extension / nucleic-acid immunoassay (`Olink`, `NULISAseq`), ultrasensitive digital/bead/planar immunoassays (`Simoa`, `Luminex`, `RBM`, `MSD`), and mass spectrometry (`DIA/SWATH`, `DDA`, `Orbitrap Astral`, `timsTOF`, `TMT/iTRAQ`, nanoparticle-enriched `Proteograph`, targeted `MRM/PRM` panels) measuring multiplexed protein targets (`>= 5` proteins or explicit proteomic/pQTL framing).
* **All human biological matrices:** EDTA/citrate/heparin plasma, serum, whole blood / dried blood spots, cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), brain and solid tissues, urine, saliva, and primary human cell types / iPSCs.
* **Preprints included:** Active preprints are included and automatically linked (`superseded_by`) once published in a peer-reviewed journal.
* **No sample-size threshold:** Studies of any sample size (`N >= 1`) are eligible so tissue-specific, pediatric, rare-disease, and underrepresented-ancestry pGWAS are captured alongside biobank-scale cohorts.
* **All data-sharing tiers:** Studies are catalogued regardless of summary-statistics availability (`Genome-wide`, `Gene-region`, `Top-hits`, or `Unavailable`).

### Exclusion Criteria
* **Secondary summary-statistics consumers:** Two-sample Mendelian randomisation (`2SMR`), `SMR/HEIDI`, colocalisation-only, or proteome-wide association studies (`PWAS`) that exclusively reuse previously published pGWAS summary statistics or pre-trained weights without generating new primary genotype-to-protein associations.
* **Non-germline or non-proteomic studies:** Pure DNA-methylation epigenome-wide association studies (`EWAS`), somatic-only tumour proteomics without germline pQTL mapping, transcript-only `eQTL` studies, non-genotyped twin heritability models, or single-analyte (`< 5` proteins) clinical biomarker GWAS.
* **Non-human studies & non-original articles:** Model-organism-only studies without a human primary pGWAS cohort, narrative reviews, editorials, and commentaries.
:::

::: {.about-section}
## 3. Use of Automated Pipelines & AI in Search and Extraction

Because ~85–90% of recent literature matching `"proteomics" AND "GWAS"` consists of secondary two-sample MR papers reusing public summary statistics, candidate screening and initial metadata extraction use a transparent two-stage automated pipeline:

1. **Automated Dual-Axis Triage (`src/run_literature_search.R`):**
   Every deduplicated record is scored on two orthogonal axes — primary data-generation signals (`P_score`: direct cohort assaying, pQTL discovery counts, genotyping/imputation/software methods) versus secondary reuse signals (`S_score`: downloading public summary statistics, `IVW`/`MR-Egger` boilerplate) — paired with a germline proteogenomic anchor ensuring primary pGWAS that *also* perform downstream MR are retained while pure secondary consumers and non-genetic biomarker cohorts are deprioritised.
2. **Four-Tier Cascading Extraction (`src/extract_candidate_study.R`):**
   For actionable candidates, an automated extractor retrieves and records atomic per-field provenance across:
   * **Tier 1:** Structured metadata APIs (Europe PMC, PubMed XML, Crossref, Unpaywall, GWAS Catalog v2).
   * **Tier 2:** Legal open-access full-text JATS XML and NCBI PMC BioC sections (`Methods`, `Results`, `Data Availability`), without bypassing paywalls or access controls.
   * **Tier 3:** Open supplementary spreadsheets/documents (`.xlsx`, `.docx`, BioC PDFs via EBI BioStudies and NCBI `supplmat`), 1-hop data-portal preflight checks (Synapse, Zenodo, deCODE), and sentinel `rsID` coordinate checks to verify `genome_build` when build names are omitted from text.
   * **Tier 4:** Conflict and completeness checks that emit draft catalogue rows alongside explicit `NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW` checklists whenever mandatory fields are missing, ambiguous, or behind closed-access Methods.
:::

::: {.about-section}
## 4. Role of Human Review & Curation Provenance Badges

Automated searches never publish directly to the live catalogue; every update opens a **GitHub Pull Request** gated by schema validation and human review. Each row in the catalogue displays one of three explicit provenance badges inside its expanded **OTHER** panel (`CURATION`):

* **`AI-extracted`** — Metadata was populated automatically by the 4-tier extraction pipeline from open-access text, supplements, and repository APIs, and has passed automated schema checks pending full human sign-off.
* **`Human-reviewed`** — Automated extraction flagged one or more missing, closed-access, or ambiguous fields (`NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW`), and a human reviewer checked the paper/supplements to verify and complete the record.
* **`Human-curated`** — Every phenotype, genetic, build/strand, cohort-overlap, and access field was curated and verified end-to-end by a human researcher against the full publication, supplementary tables, and downloaded summary statistics.
:::
